summary: Rehearsed on the clone's copy of production: Step 1 (Copy again and the context copy, one organization at a time) finished green, then pressed for every organization, undone with a new-system edit carried back, Step 1 again, pressed again, and undone again. Step 1 covered 13 organizations' context copies across rehearsals 12 and 13 (12 in rehearsal 12; Alex Hart's Workspace, the largest, only on the batched tag copy).
